metadata.leakage_rule: No Episode 8 or Episode 9 evidence, retrospective explanation, outcome, or formulation is included.
metadata.methodology: Episode-coded nodes are retained as immutable observations. Canonical nodes synthesise repeated mechanisms; every synthesis is linked back to supporting episode nodes. Inferences remain labelled by evidence status.
metadata.pseudonymisation_notice: Neutral research identifiers replace cast and clinician names. Distinctive publicly broadcast histories may still permit re-identification; this release is pseudonymised, not anonymous.
metadata.representation_rule: Retrieve typed situations, interpretations, behaviours, goals, partner effects and evidence-linked longitudinal mechanisms. Do not expose a chronological memory stream as a separate representation.
